verdict.line: You lose if you let trades drag on near her tentacle terrain and she lands Test of Spirit on you repeatedly; you win if you hook her into short, dash-reset all-ins before level 6 while she's away from walls.

brief.thesis: This is classified EVEN with Kled holding solo-kill advantage, but the 37.5% head-to-head win rate over 48 games shows how badly it flips if you let the fight drag out. Kled's whole kit is built around short, violent windows — Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) yanks her out of position, W (Violent Tendencies) adds a 4-hit attack-speed burst, E (Jousting) lets you dash in and recast back through her. Illaoi's power instead comes from sustained skirmishes: Tentacle Smash procs, Harsh Lesson leaps, and Test of Spirit echoes that punish you for staying in extended exchanges, especially near impassible terrain where her passive tentacles spawn.

theirWindow.when: When E lands near wall-spawned tentacles
theirWindow.what: Test of Spirit (16/15/14/13/12s cooldown, 900 range) rips a spirit from you that echoes a percentage of damage dealt to it back onto you, and if it dies or you outrun it you become a Vessel that spawns more tentacles. Do not trade into the spirit — disengage with E (Jousting) and eat the Vessel timer passively rather than feeding the echo.

yourWindow.what: Before her E rotation is smooth and before tentacles have accumulated on nearby terrain, Illaoi has no sustain crutch. Use Q's 800-range hook to yank her onto open ground, then chain E in and W's attack-speed burst to force a short trade she can't out-heal.

boots.why: 85.7% pick rate; both her autos and tentacle swings are physical damage, so flat reduction blunts every extended skirmish she tries to start.

runes.keystoneWhy: This page runs at 62.5% win rate in this matchup versus 25% on the Conqueror page — the extra max health and proc heal buy Skaarl's HP bar more room against her poke, so you're not forced to dismount before you get to use your own all-in window.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 78.2% of games here with a 41.9% win rate; Ignite secures the early solo kills Kled is favored for and denies the heal-back from her tentacle and Q procs in a close trade.

playing.title: Hook her off walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassible terrain, so use Q's 800-range yank to drag her away from tri-bush and river walls before you commit to a fight.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Your solo-kill advantage is real but front-loaded; force fights in the 3-5 window before her R (Leap of Faith) and tentacle stacking come online.

playing.title: Never trade into her Spirit
playing.detail: Test of Spirit echoes a percentage of damage dealt to the spirit back onto you — walk away and eat the Vessel transition instead of fighting back.

playing.title: Double-dash the recast on E
playing.detail: Jousting can be recast to dash back through your initial target for a second hit of damage — use it both to extend damage and to disengage from her Spirit.

playing.title: Watch your own Skaarl HP
playing.detail: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and loses Q for Pocket Pistol, so don't commit a full combo if Skaarl's bar is already low going in.

playing.title: Time W for the burst window
playing.detail: Violent Tendencies' 4-hit attack-speed burst (strongest on the 4th hit) should land during your all-in, not while poking at range where she can just walk off.

playing.title: Clear the wave before she can Vessel you in it
playing.detail: If you're forced into Vessel status, step off minions so her tentacles aren't also hitting you alongside the Vessel tick.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the win rates, pick rates, and sample sizes are real OP.GG data. The tactical reasoning — when to all-in, how to play around Test of Spirit, and why Grasp edges out Conqueror here — is my own read on the ability interactions, not measured data.
